enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Stir. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and butter. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Whisk. Pour into pan. Cook. Flip. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open drawer. Take fork. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Check mirror. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Buckle seatbelt. Adjust mirror. Start engine. Drive. Stop at red light. Turn. Park car. Unbuckle. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on lab coat. Check patient list. Review medical records. Enter patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Consult with colleague. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Return to work. See more patients. Write notes. Clock out.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Buckle seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at red light. Turn. Park car. Unbuckle. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to door. Unlock door. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add to pot. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve into bowl. Open drawer. Take spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Rinse.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Pause. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying or reviewing medical notes using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on. Log in. Open document. Read notes. Highlight text. Type notes. Scroll. Open browser. Search. Read article. Take notes. Save document. Close laptop. Stand up.
Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Continue watching. Change channel. Turn off TV. Put remote down.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal hygiene and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn over. Pull blanket. Sleep. Stir. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
